title: Oracle’s Veritone AI Deal And Nashville Growth Add Context To Valuation
title_zh: 甲骨文的 Veritone AI 交易和纳什维尔的增长为估值增添了背景
summary: Oracle (NYSE:ORCL) has signed a multi year agreement for Veritone to run its AI solutions on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. The company is also expanding its physical presence in Nashville with a new long term lease and plans for additional tech roles.
summary_zh: 甲骨文（纽约证券交易所股票代码：ORCL）已与 Veritone 签署了一份多年期协议，以在甲骨文云基础设施上运行其人工智能解决方案。该公司还通过新的长期租约扩大了在纳什维尔的实体业务，并计划增加更多的技术职位。

title: Apollo Faces Liquidity Strain While Pursuing Japan Deal And Board Changes
title_zh: 阿波罗在寻求日本交易和董事会变更时面临流动性紧张
summary: Apollo Global Management (NYSE:APO) has imposed withdrawal limits on certain private credit funds following elevated investor redemption requests. The firm has agreed to acquire Nippon Sheet Glass in what it describes as its largest private equity investment to date in Japan.
summary_zh: 由于投资者赎回请求增加，阿波罗全球管理公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：APO）对某些私人信贷基金实施了提款限制。该公司已同意收购日本板硝子公司，这是该公司迄今为止在日本最大的私募股权投资。

title: Rubenstein-Backed Manna Tree Targets $500 Million Fund Amid Deal Slump
title_zh: 鲁宾斯坦支持的 Manna Tree 在交易低迷之际筹集 5 亿美元资金
summary: Wellness-focused private equity firm pursues new fund as smaller deals and portfolio growth support continued deal flow.
summary_zh: 专注于健康的私募股权公司正在寻求新基金，因为规模较小的交易和投资组合增长支持了持续的交易流。

title: M&A Deals Thriving in 2025: ETFs in Focus
title_zh: 2025 年并购交易蓬勃发展：ETF 成为焦点
summary: M&A deals are booming in 2025 despite fewer transactions -- megadeals, AI bets and Fed cuts may fuel ETFs like MNA, IAI, KBWB & CHAT.
summary_zh: 尽管交易量减少，但 2025 年并购交易仍将蓬勃发展——大型交易、人工智能押注和美联储降息可能会推动 MNA、IAI、KBWB 和 CHAT 等 ETF 的发展。
